notes.title: 10% discount on Genotype VR
notes.content:
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run for your life in an Antarctic subterranean research facility while shooting monsters and beasts with weapons that are alive?

Wonder no more! Hurry, hurry fast, to the shopstore and buypurchase the neoclassic metroidvanialike FPS action-adventure story-puzzler with incredible graphics, Genotype. Also, Kittypocalypse, Glyph and more. 

[b]Other news[/b]
The list of games on PSVR2 has recently been vastly improved by the new arrival of Genotype. It comes with:
[list]
[*] 120 fps native!
[*] FSR (Foveated) rendering with 150% focus resolution and 100% base resolution
[*] headset rumble
[*] joystick deadzone setting
[*] Improved controller haptics
[*] fog color banding
[/list]

And as of 10 April all platforms (Meta Quest, PICO, Steam, Rift, PSVR2) have seen a patch that:
[list]
[*] Fixed trophies not working while a sense controller was not logged in
[*] Fixed several trophies that were bugged and could not be unlocked
[*] Fixed a bug where you could permanently miss DNA samples by killing bosses while using the Carapace Graid Upgrade
[*] Added checks to fix saves with missing DNA samples
[/list]
